news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Q2 2026 Financial Results on August 13
news.summary: Nektar confirmed it will report Q2 2026 results after market close on Thursday, August 13, 2026, with CEO Howard Robin hosting a conference call at 5:00pm ET; as of this refresh (Aug 12) the report is one day out and remains the next major catalyst.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Nektar at Buy With $153 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash initiated coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and $153 price target, citing the rezpegaldesleukin Phase 3 opportunity in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata; the call continued to circulate in follow-on coverage into August, with consensus now Strong Buy around a $153 average target across roughly 10-11 analysts.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with shares up about 5.9% on the news; a third trial, ZENITH AD-3, is set to begin in September 2026, completing a ~1,530-patient program with initial topline data expected mid-2028 and a targeted BLA submission in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Reports Inducement Grants to 23 New Hires Under Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar's Organization and Compensation Committee granted non-qualified stock options for 36,000 shares to 23 newly-hired employees at a $64.84 strike (the July 20 closing price), a routine but notable disclosure signaling continued headcount build-out to support the newly launched ZENITH AD Phase 3 program.

news.headline: Nektar Stock Climbs 10.65% as Immunology Sector Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped as sentiment across inflammation/immunology names improved on read-through from AbbVie's prospective acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, with Nektar stock having climbed from the mid-$50s to the low-$70s over the prior weeks.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Added to Russell 2000, 2500 and 3000 Indexes
news.summary: In the annual FTSE Russell reconstitution effective June 27, 2026, Nektar was added to a wide suite of Russell indexes, including the Russell 2000, 2500 and 3000 plus several associated growth and value benchmarks, broadening the passive/index-fund ownership base ahead of the stock's summer rally.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings (after market close)
catalysts.detail: Officially confirmed date, one day out as of this refresh (2026-08-12). CEO Howard Robin will host a conference call at 5:00pm ET/2:00pm PT covering results and pipeline progress, including cash runway update following the ZENITH AD Phase 3 launch.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal Phase 3 trial (~510 biologic/JAK-inhibitor-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) set to begin dosing, completing the ~1,530-patient global ZENITH AD registrational program alongside AD-1/AD-2, which started dosing July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: NKTR-0165 preclinical data presentation
catalysts.detail: Preclinical data for NKTR-0165, a TNFR2 agonist antibody being developed with UCSF for multiple sclerosis, expected to be presented at a scientific conference.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment data
catalysts.detail: Topline data expected from the 24-week off-treatment observation period of the REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b alopecia areata extension study, assessing durability of hair regrowth after stopping rezpegaldesleukin dosing; will help inform the Phase 3 registrational design for alopecia areata.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Planned initiation of a registrational Phase 3 trial for rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata, building on strong 52-week REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b extension data reported in April 2026 and existing FDA Fast Track designation.

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 data
catalysts.detail: Phase 2 data expected for rezpegaldesleukin in patients with new-onset Type 1 diabetes mellitus.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 initial topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline readout from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 trials expected mid-2028, with a BLA submission targeted for 2029.

pulse: Nektar is one day from its August 13, 2026 Q2 earnings call, the next major near-term catalyst, after entering pivotal execution mode in July: it dosed first patients in the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 Phase 3 atopic dermatitis trials on July 21, with ZENITH AD-3 set to start in September, and continues hiring against the newly launched program (36,000-option inducement grant to 23 new employees on July 20). The stock has held in the mid-$70s since late June on improving immunology-sector sentiment, broad Russell index inclusion (June 27), and bullish sell-side coverage (Canaccord initiated Buy, $153 PT, on July 22, with consensus now Strong Buy near $153 across roughly 10-11 analysts). A new near-term readout to watch is Q4 2026 topline data from the REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment period, which will shape the alopecia areata Phase 3 design ahead of a planned early-2027 start; at Thursday's earnings, investors will focus on R&D spend tied to the AD Phase 3 launch and cash runway. Overall sentiment stays bullish on rezpegaldesleukin's multi-indication Treg biologic potential, tempered by heavy dilution from over $1B in equity raises over the past year and a long wait to the mid-2028 pivotal AD readout.
